prompt: I'm building a Next.js app with Tailwind. Add a login form to the app.
expected_behavior: Agent activates the skill, classifies the need as a block, sources login-03 from official shadcn/ui, and installs it with `npx shadcn@latest add login-03` instead of generating a form from scratch.
criteria: Agent does not hand-write the form markup when a prebuilt login block exists
Agent runs the official shadcn CLI with the correct item name
Agent checks components.json exists and runs `npx shadcn@latest init` first if it doesn't

prompt: Start a brand new Vite + React + Tailwind app and build the marketing landing page for a SaaS.
expected_behavior: Agent activates the skill even though shadcn is not yet installed, runs `npx shadcn@latest init`, then sources hero/pricing/feature sections from official shadcn/ui or the free shadcnspace subset rather than generating sections from scratch.
criteria: Agent treats greenfield as in-scope and initializes shadcn before adding items
Agent prefers official shadcn/ui before shadcnspace at each sourcing decision
Agent does not generate full landing sections from scratch when free blocks exist

prompt: I want a hero section with an animated gradient for my Tailwind app. Find me one from that shadcn space site.
expected_behavior: Agent fetches https://shadcnspace.com/r/registry.json, filters items with meta.isPro === false, proposes only free heroes (hero-01, hero-02, hero-03, hero-33), and installs via `npx shadcn@latest add https://shadcnspace.com/r/hero-01.json` — never proposing Pro items or mentioning purchasing.
criteria: Agent filters the registry by the isPro flag rather than guessing which items are free
Agent uses the URL registry form (no components.json registries configuration required)
Agent never recommends hero-04 through hero-52 or any paid-gated item
Agent does not mention pricing, tiers, or licenses as an option to the user

prompt: Can you set up that admin dashboard from shadcnspace? I saw it has 197+ components.
expected_behavior: Agent declines the Admin Dashboard under the free-only rule without suggesting the user buy a license, explains it is premium-only, and offers the free alternative: official shadcn/ui dashboard blocks (dashboard-01 etc.) installed via `npx shadcn@latest add dashboard-01`.
criteria: Agent refuses the paid-gated Admin Dashboard outright
Agent does not walk the user toward the pricing page or a purchase
Agent offers a concrete free alternative from official shadcn/ui

prompt: Add a subtle animated number ticker and a text reveal effect to my landing page.
expected_behavior: Agent activates the skill and splits the needs by character: the number ticker (functional widget) from animata.design (copy-paste, MIT); the text reveal (dramatic text animation) from React Bits via `npx shadcn@latest add @react-bits/<Name>-TS-TW`. No hand-written animation logic.
criteria: Agent sources the ticker from animata.design rather than hand-writing it
Agent sources the text reveal from React Bits via the @react-bits shadcn CLI namespace with a valid variant suffix
Agent copies animata component source into the project (animata has no CLI)
Agent verifies Tailwind and the per-component dependencies

prompt: I want a wow-factor animated 3D background for my landing page hero.
expected_behavior: Agent activates the skill, classifies the need as a dramatic animated effect, sources a Backgrounds component from React Bits (free tier, reactbits.dev), and installs it via `npx shadcn@latest add @react-bits/<Name>-TS-TW`, letting the CLI auto-install declared dependencies (three, motion, gsap).
criteria: Agent uses a React Bits Backgrounds component rather than hand-writing WebGL/animation code
Agent installs via the @react-bits namespace with a variant suffix matching the project (e.g. -TS-TW)
Agent stays on reactbits.dev only — never proposes anything from pro.reactbits.dev or mentions pricing

prompt: Build a landing page where the hero text reveals word by word on scroll and a section pins while the user scrolls through three feature panels.
expected_behavior: Agent first checks the free sources for prebuilt pieces (e.g. React Bits animated text); for the scroll-pinning sequence with no prebuilt fit, it builds custom motion with GSAP — ScrollTrigger for pinning/scrubbing and SplitText for the reveal — using the useGSAP() hook from @gsap/react.
criteria: Agent checks prebuilt sources (React Bits, animata) before writing custom animation
Agent uses GSAP ScrollTrigger for pinning/scrub rather than IntersectionObserver or raw scroll listeners
Agent uses useGSAP() from @gsap/react for React integration and cleanup
Agent treats GSAP and all plugins as free and proposes no paid alternatives

prompt: My project uses Material UI with React. I need a nice pricing table.
expected_behavior: Agent does not activate the skill's sourcing flow; the shadcn CLI and these sources do not apply to MUI. Agent builds or sources MUI-appropriate UI instead.
criteria: Agent does not run the shadcn CLI in an MUI project
Agent does not install shadcn/Tailwind components into an MUI codebase
